envelope.description: team init and team refresh commands

body.title: team init and team refresh commands
body.summary: Add src/cli/services/team.ts with teamInit and teamRefresh, the team entry in the Services interface and makeServices in src/cli/services/index.ts, the help lines and the team dispatch case with runTeam (sub words init and refresh, optional path, --branch flag) in src/cli/command.ts, one-line result formatting and cross-prefixed error rendering, and add the team entry to the two test facades.
acceptanceChecks: team init and team refresh dispatch with an optional path and the context repo as default.
team refresh --branch passes the name through and the refusal that asks for it is rendered.
A thrown error from either command renders as a cross-prefixed line.
The existing command and TUI tests still run with the facades carrying the team entry.
A team refresh followed by a reader call in a temp clone returns the policy end to end.

tests.name: src/cli/__tests__/command.test.ts: team init writes the starter and reports its path
src/cli/__tests__/command.test.ts: team refresh runs the refresh and reports the outcome
src/cli/__tests__/command.test.ts: team refresh --branch passes the name through and renders the refusal that asks for it
src/cli/__tests__/command.test.ts: a thrown error from either team command renders as a cross-prefixed line
src/cli/__tests__/tui.test.ts: the TUI tests run with fakeServices carrying the team entry
